The black death wipes out most of Europe, about a third of it. The last great conqueror is Timberlane, who conquers much of the world from his base. This shows that historically, innovative, open, aggressive, and courageous people are the greatest conquerors. However, with the development of gunpowder, civilization will eventually conquer these steps people, marking a significant turning point in history.

The step people worship horses, sky gods, cows, and valor, while modern humans may be atheists who worship money, materialism, or science. Every culture has a religion that answers questions about where we come from, why we are here, and where we are going. In this class, we'll continue discussing human history next session.
